purpose: Portable identity and temporal contract for future PostgreSQL migration with minimal maintenance and collision-safe backfill.

primary_id.generation_rule: Generate UUIDv7 once with a standards-compliant generator and persist it. Never regenerate an existing entity id on rerun.

business_keys.rule: Human-readable identifiers remain separate from id and receive explicit uniqueness constraints where appropriate.

foreign_keys.rule: Relationships reference immutable UUID ids through *_id fields; mutable names, labels and filenames are not relational identity.

backfill_contract.mapping_rule: Persist legacy natural key -> UUIDv7 before writing migrated rows. A rerun reuses that mapping instead of generating a new UUID.
backfill_contract.collision_rule: If a proposed natural key identifies more than one source record, stop the migration and require explicit resolution. Never silently overwrite, merge, renumber or choose the first row.
backfill_contract.missing_key_rule: Records without a trustworthy natural key require an explicit migration decision; array position must not be substituted.
backfill_contract.idempotence_rule: The same migration input plus persisted mapping must resolve to the same entity ids on every rerun.

current_entity_time.created_at: first known creation time; immutable once established
current_entity_time.effective_at: time from which the Current definition is authoritative

historical_event_time.occurred_at: time the historical event actually occurred, when known
historical_event_time.recorded_at: time the event/evidence was captured by the system
historical_event_time.entity_id: immutable UUID reference to the Current entity whose history is being described

timestamp_format.unknown_time_rule: Use null when an exact time is unknown. Never invent a timestamp for backfill.

authority_direction.rule: Current Authority interprets History; History is evidence/reference and never defines Current Authority.

postgresql_index_policy.business_uniqueness: Use separate UNIQUE constraints for governed natural keys.
postgresql_index_policy.temporal_indexes: Add ordinary indexes to effective_at / occurred_at only when query plans require them; timestamps never become entity identity.
